evals.prompt: Set up a new automation script called 's3-export' — it reads records, batches them, and writes an export file. It needs AWS access via a profile.
evals.expected_output: States that /starting-work is invoked first, emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm scaffold:script s3-export --purpose "..."` before the install and build lines, names the generated files including `scripts/s3-export/src/config.ts` (with `AWS_PROFILE_PARAM_NAME`) and `scripts/s3-export/src/main.ts` (thin composition root), and states the handoff to `implementing-scripts` as the final step.
expectations: Mentions invoking the `/starting-work` skill as the first step before emitting any `WOULD-RUN` line for the generator, install, or build
Emits a line beginning `WOULD-RUN: pnpm scaffold:script s3-export` that includes a `--purpose` flag, and this line appears before any `WOULD-RUN: pnpm install` line
Emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm install` before `WOULD-RUN: pnpm build`, and `WOULD-RUN: pnpm build` before `WOULD-RUN: pnpm --filter @m3l-automation/s3-export start`
Names `scripts/s3-export/src/config.ts` among the files the generator emits and states it must include `AWS_PROFILE_PARAM_NAME` because the script touches AWS
Names `scripts/s3-export/src/main.ts` as a thin composition root with business logic delegated to a `steps/` module
States the handoff to the `implementing-scripts` skill as the final step, after the smoke-run step

evals.prompt: Add a report-generator automation under scripts/ — CLI only, no AWS. It should take a batchSize config parameter.
evals.expected_output: Emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm scaffold:script report-generator --purpose "..."` before the install and build lines, names `scripts/report-generator/src/config.ts` with a `batchSize` parameter and no AWS profile parameter, and states the handoff to `implementing-scripts`.
expectations: Emits a line beginning `WOULD-RUN: pnpm scaffold:script report-generator` that includes a `--purpose` flag, and this line appears before any `WOULD-RUN: pnpm install` line
Emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm install` before `WOULD-RUN: pnpm build`, and `WOULD-RUN: pnpm build` before `WOULD-RUN: pnpm --filter @m3l-automation/report-generator start`
Names `scripts/report-generator/src/config.ts` among the generated files and states it includes a `batchSize` parameter with a schema-time validator
Does NOT mention `AWS_PROFILE_PARAM_NAME` because the script is CLI-only with no AWS access
States the handoff to the `implementing-scripts` skill as the final step, after the smoke-run step

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new script called s3-export — the batching logic and AWS wiring.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects scripts/s3-export/ already exists and stops, telling the user to implement/edit the existing script directly rather than re-scaffolding it.
expectations: Explicitly states that `scripts/s3-export/` already exists and that re-scaffolding should not proceed
Does NOT emit any `WOULD-RUN: pnpm scaffold:script` line
Redirects the user to use `implementing-scripts` (or edit the script directly) instead of re-scaffolding, and this redirect appears before any description of scaffold steps
Does not name any new files to be created under `scripts/s3-export/src/`

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new module for the library — a 'cache' capability. Nothing exists for it yet.
evals.expected_output: Skill recognizes this is a library module request, not a consumer script, and redirects to the `scaffolding-submodules` skill without describing any steps for scripts/.
expectations: Explicitly identifies the request as a library module (not a consumer script under `scripts/`)
Redirects to the `scaffolding-submodules` skill as the correct skill, and this redirect appears before any description of generator steps or file creation
Does NOT emit any `WOULD-RUN: pnpm scaffold:script` line or name any `scripts/cache/` path
